units.function: Embedded-Postgres behavioral tests for detecting stalled or high-churn assigned issues, creating manager-owned productivity-review issues, refreshing them, suppressing repeated recovery loops and holding continuation after a no-comment trigger.
units.dependencyDirection: Heartbeat runs, issue comments, issue/activity history and hierarchy feed a server reconciliation service that writes ordinary issues/comments/activity rows and assigns review work to the worker Agent's manager.
units.keyDataModels: Company; manager and worker Agents; source and review issues; originKind/originId/originFingerprint; heartbeat run contextSnapshot/liveness/nextAction; issue comments with createdByRunId; activity log; requestDepth; configurable streak, interval, cap and suppression thresholds.
units.lifecycle: Scan assigned work; infer no-comment, long-duration or high-churn triggers; create one fingerprinted review; periodically append bounded refresh comments; snooze after done/cancelled review; suppress repeated no-action cycles; optionally soft-hold continuation and record an activity event.
units.testAssessment: The 15 cases are unusually focused on operational loop safety: serial idempotency, rate/cap bounds, action windows, cancelled-state semantics, recursion prevention, snooze behavior, soft-stop logging and poisoned-depth clamping. They do not prove concurrent idempotency or failure recovery and do not test authorization, accountable-human escalation, policy provenance, evidence quality, permission/data/cost risk or appeals. The suite was skipped because embedded PostgreSQL is unavailable on this host, so behavior is source-evidenced rather than locally executed.
units.designRationale: Turn weak productivity signals into bounded manager review work instead of endlessly retrying an Agent, while reusing the issue hierarchy, comment stream and activity log for visibility and recovery coordination.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs early warning for blocked, looping or low-evidence work and must stop autonomous continuation without flooding the organization, while preserving who is accountable for the intervention and why.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the idempotent origin fingerprint, time-window/cap mechanics, recursion exclusion, cancelled/done snooze, explicit continuation hold and recovery-loop throttle. Replace run-count/comment heuristics with typed work, plan, tool, evidence, result, risk, permission, data-egress and cost projections. Route escalation to the accountable human or delegated approver under a versioned policy, expose explanation/appeal, and preserve trigger inputs plus decisions as immutable responsibility evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: Paperclip assigns the review to an Agent manager and treats comments/activity as action evidence; neither proves a responsible human saw, authorized or resolved the condition. A soft hold without human ownership, approval semantics and evidence binding is operational supervision, not organizational accountability.

2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 15 tests skipped because embedded PostgreSQL support was unavailable; no pass claimed
units.securityFindings: HIGH accountability gap: escalation defaults to an Agent manager with no accountable-human acknowledgement or approval record. HIGH concurrency gap: serial double reconciliation is tested, but no multi-worker race, database uniqueness or transaction rollback case appears. HIGH signal-integrity gap: successful run counts and comment presence are proxies that can be gamed and do not validate evidence/results. MEDIUM governance gap: threshold changes, trigger explanation, appeal and false-positive outcomes are not policy-versioned/audited here. POSITIVE: bounded refreshes, 24-hour caps, no-action suppression, descendant exclusion, snooze windows, soft-stop logging and depth clamping directly address runaway recovery behavior.
